Good morning Maria,

We would just like to confirm whether you will be checking out today, as today is the start date of your extension booking.

Please note that our standard check-out time is 12:00 PM. If you are planning to check out today, it would need to be completed by 12:00 PM, rather than 9:00 PM.

Kindly confirm your check-out time with us.

Thank you.
